experiment: joint distribution of the two chain-set gates over extracted interventions
SCOPE_NOTE: Both axes are LLM assignments that the judge protocol does not score. This is the composition of the extracted corpus with respect to the two gates, not a measured property of the literature. The corner is a necessary condition for an intervention to end a gate-selected chain, not a sufficient one: the path reaching it must also clear the confidence gate at every hop.

definitions.x: intervention_maturity 1..4 as assigned by the extractor
definitions.y_primary: highest edge_confidence among structural edges incident to the intervention (max: a path needs one sufficiently confident edge to arrive)
definitions.y_secondary: lowest such confidence, the stricter reading
